name: infinite-bookshelf
description: Turn a topic into a complete book, written live by the AI model of your choice.

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && cd api && uv sync
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd api && uv run ruff check --fix && uv run ruff format
scripts.lint: prettier --check . && pnpm --filter @infinite-bookshelf/web lint && cd api && uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @infinite-bookshelf/web test && cd api && uv run pytest
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm --filter @infinite-bookshelf/web typecheck && pnpm test
